nav.label: Pages and agents
tasks.lead: What waits for you and what is in progress, read from every document's marked sections and the agent ledger. Open a card for its detail.
tasks.noCommits: No commit has touched this document yet.
err.tasks-no-python: The Tasks page needs Python: start the dashboard with dashboard serve, which names it.
err.tasks-index-failed: md-format could not read the documents; the dashboard's terminal says why.
err.unknown-file: That document is not in the index.
err.git-failed: git could not read this document's commits.
theme.label: Theme: {mode}
loadError: The dashboard server did not answer: {error}
agents.lead: Peter, Aster and May at work on this computer. Open an agent for its sessions and questions.
view.label: Views
search.label: Search this board
field.title: Title
peek.missing: This item is not on the board now.
q.title: Questions from {agent}
q.saved: Saved. {agent} picks it up and carries on.
q.busy: The mailbox is busy; try again in a moment.
codex.lead: What Codex is doing on this computer: every thread from the app, the terminal and Aster's runs. A prompt sent from here spends the Codex account's quota.
codex.notStartedFix: Check that Codex is installed (codex --version in a terminal), or set CODEX_CMD to a JSON array holding the full path of codex.exe, such as ["C:\\…\\codex.exe"], then restart dashboard serve.
codex.signedOut: Codex is not signed in on this computer.
codex.signInOpened: ChatGPT's sign-in opened in a new tab. Finish there; this page updates when it is done.
claude.lead: What Claude Code is doing on this computer: every session from the desktop app and the terminal, and those that ended in the last 24 hours. Open one to watch its last steps, read-only, with every secret masked.
claude.noSteps: No steps to show in the last 20.
claude.unreadable: This session's history cannot be read.
claude.commitsUnreadable: Not readable: the folder is gone, is not a git repository, or git failed.
thread.none: Nothing of this kind in the last 20 turns.
run.newLead: It starts in the dev workspace folder, read-only unless you choose workspace-write for this prompt.
tb.lead: Codex Taskboard, the local issue board, shown here while it runs on this computer.
tb.start: Start it on this computer with
tb.local: It stays on this computer: it answers on 127.0.0.1 and nowhere else.
err.codex-not-started: Codex did not start, or it stopped.
err.codex-timeout: Codex did not answer in time; try again.
err.thread-busy: This thread is already running, here or in another Codex window.
err.write-outside-dev: Workspace-write is allowed only in a thread whose folder is the dev workspace.
err.unknown-turn: This turn was not started from this page, or it has ended.
err.not-found: There is no such thread, session or subagent now.
err.bad-request: The request was incomplete; check the prompt and try again.
err.bad-sign-in: Codex sent a sign-in address that is not https://, so it was not opened.
err.forbidden: The dashboard server refused the request; open the dashboard at its own address on this computer.
err.internal: The dashboard server hit an unexpected error; try again.
err.other: The dashboard server did not answer as expected; try again.
